---
title: "Choose between options"
description: "How much each criterion weighs, and which option ranks best."
---

[Documentation](../../docs.html) / [Methods](../../docs.html#methods)

How much each criterion weighs, and which option ranks best.

**Assumptions.** Consistent pairwise judgements (a consistency ratio below .10) and a performance score for each option on each criterion.

In SurveyStudio, open Plan, add a research question, choose the method and assign each variable its role. Declare the hypotheses and the decision rule before the data arrives.

## Analytic hierarchy process (AHP)

![The Plan card for a Analytic hierarchy process (AHP) block, from the `mcdm_choice` demo.](../../../docs/methods/ahp.png){width=90%}

In the pre-analysis plan:

> **RQ1.** What weight does each criterion carry?
> **Planned decision rule:** Accept the pairwise judgements when the consistency ratio is below .10.

In the report: the APA 7 sentence, a table and a chart, each titled with the research question.

References: Saaty, T. L. (1980). *The analytic hierarchy process*. McGraw-Hill.
